summary: Investigate firmware runtime bugs such as faults, hangs, wrong values and silent peripherals by inspecting a live Cortex-M debug session through the CMSIS Debugger instead of adding prints.
triggers: HardFaults and other faults, crashes, hangs, failing tests
wrong/null values that are right in simulation but wrong on hardware
code that never reaches the line you expect
stop_conditions: If the debugger cannot be used — no probe, no `launch.json`, a board that does not enumerate — say what the concrete blocker is before falling back to another method.
`initializing` | Wait, ask again. Do **not** issue a second start.
`unresponsive` | `check_target_connection`; ... `restart_debugging` and `load_and_debug` re-flash and reset, and lose that state: last, and only once the user accepts the loss.
If `launch.json` is stale, the user has to regenerate it: **CMSIS Solution → Manage Solution → Debugger → Apply**. You cannot do that step for them.
Use them after the decoded fault and frame are recorded, or when the user accepts that loss.
Never start a GDB server yourself.

If the user has the MS Serial Monitor open on the same device, the OS will not give you the tty (`PORT_HELD`). ... Then ask the user to stop monitoring the port there, and read it with `serial_capture` once it is free. Do not take the user's port silently.
When no rule decides — two windows debugging at once, or several idle ones — it refuses to guess and asks you to choose
`WORKER_TIMEOUT` ... call `get_session_status` and ask the user to look at that window before you repeat the call.
`WINDOW_UNREACHABLE` ... call `list_debug_windows`, and if the window is still listed, ask the user to reload it.

extracted.title: Cortex-M breakpoint budget
extracted.body: Breakpoints in flash use the FPB code comparators: 4 on Cortex-M0/M0+/M23, 6 on M3/M4, 8 on M7/M33/M55/M85. A device can implement fewer; FP_CTRL at 0xE0002000 gives the count on the target. Past it, breakpoints silently fail to bind or the adapter reports an error. In RAM, software breakpoints are unlimited.

extracted.title: Probe wedged during fault read
extracted.body: If a fault read answers PROBE_WEDGED, the debug port no longer answers (DHCSR could not be read either): stop reading and follow the hint. An attach session reconnects with cmsis_action detach, then attach, without a reset. A load_and_debug session owns its GDB server: the user restarts that server without a reset, and you cmsis_action attach. Only then restart_debugging, reset or load_and_debug again.

extracted.title: Serial port held by MS Serial Monitor
extracted.body: If the user has the MS Serial Monitor open on the same device, the OS will not give you the tty (PORT_HELD). serial_subscribe_monitor reads that session only where the Serial Monitor's API exposes a data event; API version 0 has none, so the call is refused and says why. Then ask the user to stop monitoring the port there, and read it with serial_capture once it is free.

extracted.title: Reads rejected while target is running
extracted.body: running rejects step_over, step_into, step_out, continue_execution, read_memory, read_core_registers, read_peripheral_register, read_cycle_counter, get_fault_info, diagnose_fault, evaluate_expression, get_call_stack, get_frame_variables, get_threads, list_variable_names and get_variables_values: call pause_execution first.
